identity.title: [v0.92][runtime-v3][integration] Wire resident Shepherd continuity into Spot reclamation

values.summary: Validate and review the reuse-first packet, bind #414, implement the smallest resident/Spot bridge, prove complete population recovery and multi-resident CPU habitability locally, obtain fresh exact-head review, publish, observe CI, and finish if green.

steps.action: Freshly review and approve the exact reuse-only Runtime-v2, CSM capsule, signed LiveContinuity, IMDSv2, retained-volume, and Linux bootstrap design.
Integrate multiple distinct resident agents through the existing lifecycle, snapshot, capsule, signed checkpoint, restore-before-admission, and fail-closed Spot callback authorities.

Retain deterministic complete-population proof and one nonqualifying pinned llama3.1:8b Q4 cold/dehydrate/restore/warm reference proof; preserve Qwen/Phi attempts as exploratory non-proof and defer exact three-model Linux r7 measurement/artifact staging to #268.
Validate exact scope, obtain fresh exact-head implementation review, publish with closing linkage, require green CI, finish, validate terminal cache/ancestry, and clean the worktree.

invariants: Every admitted resident appears exactly once in a completed generation
Restore and exact population validation precede admission
Runtime continuity storage is distinct from build cache
Existing Runtime v2 lifecycle, snapshot, lineage, invariant, and wake authority remains authoritative
risks: A bridge could accidentally duplicate existing recovery authority
Resource proof could become non-proving if model execution overlaps compilation
Population or storage ambiguity could falsely permit admission
stop_conditions: Need to invent a lifecycle state, snapshot schema, lineage, or recovery policy
Cannot prove exact complete-population restore before admission
Cannot keep Runtime continuity storage distinct from build cache
Resource proof exceeds 64 GiB or lacks nonzero useful-work denominators
